input: Find summer camps that have already announced 2027 dates for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania, Polk, Haywood and Jackson counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon, Waynesville, Sylva). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures: July 19–23, 2027; rising grades 1–7, with teen assistants in grades 8–12.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: 2027 day sessions June 14–July 29; forest camp near Brevard and a Ramblers backpacking program also listed.

candidates.name: Braveheart Grief Ministries
candidates.note: Camp Braveheart at Ridge Haven: June 7–12, 2027, for students in grades 4–12.

candidates.name: Southland Camps
candidates.note: High-school summer camp at Ridge Haven: June 7–12, 2027.

candidates.name: Ridge Haven
candidates.note: Published its 2027 Brevard dates-and-rates schedule; registration opens November 3, 2026.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight sessions June 6–August 6, 2027; options for kindergarten through ninth grade.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys’ one- to four-week sessions June 6–August 14, 2027, for grades K–10 depending on session.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley
candidates.note: 2027 dates and rates published; Main Camp and Mountainside, Riverside and Young Leaders programs serve grades K–10.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Published 2027 overnight dates and rates; girls ages 6–16, with traditional and specialty riding programs.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: 2027 session dates published; Christian girls’ camp serving grades 2–11.

candidates.name: Camp Kanuga
candidates.note: Published 2027 summer dates and rates; coed Episcopal-affiliated camp, with registration opening October 1, 2026.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: 2027 summer schedule and pricing published for day and resident camps for boys and girls.

candidates.name: Camp Pinewood
candidates.note: Coed overnight camp; 2027 introductory, first, second and full sessions run June 13–August 3.

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer
candidates.note: Junior Main Camp announced for June 6–July 8, 2027, serving rising K5–ninth grade.

candidates.name: Camp Arrowhead for Boys
candidates.note: Published 2027 one-, two- and three-week sessions, including outdoor skills, woodworking and maker activities.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight programs; Junior Camp for grades 1–4 is August 8–13, 2027, alongside longer sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Christian girls’ overnight camp; official September 2026 announcement confirms published 2027 dates and rates.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Published 2027 session schedule; boys ages 6–17, with outdoor activities and wilderness trips.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Published 2027 dates and rates for girls’ overnight sessions; serves ages 6–17.

candidates.name: Miller Eventing
candidates.note: Equestrian summer camp at FENCE: July 7–11, 2027; age eligibility not stated in the announcement.

candidates.name: Skyland Camp and Retreats
candidates.note: 2027 girls’ starter session June 26–July 4; mother-daughter camp for ages 6–10 July 15–18.

candidates.name: Daniel Boone Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Daniel Boone: seven 2027 weeks June 6–July 24, with base camp, high-adventure treks and Boonesboro Village.

candidates.name: M28 Ministries
candidates.note: Middle- and high-school church-group camps; Mountain 1 announced for June 23–26, 2027.

candidates.name: P.R. Running Camp
candidates.note: Middle- and high-school running camps at WCU: July 11–15 and July 17–21, 2027.

candidates.name: YM360
candidates.note: GENERATE student camp at Western Carolina University: July 19–23, 2027.
